question: Will Benjamin Netanyahu remain Prime Minister through the end of 2026?
description: This market resolves YES if Netanyahu continues as Prime Minister of Israel until December 31, 2026. Resolves NO if he leaves office for any reason (resignation, no-confidence vote, coalition collapse, etc.) before that date.

question: Will there be early Knesset elections in 2026?
description: This market resolves YES if Israeli Knesset elections are held before the scheduled date in late 2026. Resolves NO if no early elections occur or if elections happen on schedule.

question: Will the judicial reform bill pass by end of 2026?
description: This market resolves YES if comprehensive judicial reform legislation is passed and enacted into law by December 31, 2026. Resolves NO if no such reform passes.

question: Will Israel sign a normalization agreement with Saudi Arabia in 2026?
description: This market resolves YES if Israel and Saudi Arabia sign an official diplomatic normalization agreement in 2026. Resolves NO if no such agreement is signed.

question: Will the current coalition government remain intact through 2026?
description: This market resolves YES if Netanyahu's current coalition partners all remain in government until December 31, 2026. Resolves NO if any coalition party leaves.

question: Will Benny Gantz return to government in 2026?
description: This market resolves YES if Benny Gantz (National Unity party leader) joins the government in any capacity in 2026. Resolves NO if he remains in opposition.

question: Will Yair Lapid's party win the most seats in the next election?
description: This market resolves YES if Yesh Atid (led by Yair Lapid) wins more Knesset seats than any other party in the next election. Resolves NO otherwise.

question: Will Itamar Ben-Gvir remain as National Security Minister through 2026?
description: This market resolves YES if Itamar Ben-Gvir continues as National Security Minister until December 31, 2026. Resolves NO if he is removed or resigns.

question: Will Israel conduct a major military operation in Gaza in 2026?
description: This market resolves YES if Israel launches a significant military ground operation in Gaza involving thousands of troops in 2026. Resolves NO if no such operation occurs.

question: Will the Bank of Israel lower interest rates below 4% in 2026?
description: This market resolves YES if the Bank of Israel's key interest rate falls below 4.00% at any point in 2026. Resolves NO if rates remain at or above 4%.
